request: Owner, 7 Nov (late): «можно добавить дизайн-решения, иллюстрации… Веспи, но не везде, не на каждом шагу… не прям левитирующие иконки… итальянские места, достопримечательности… чтобы это было пространство… не на каждом шагу, а через 2–3».
use: Scenery beside the cabinet road (PortalRoad, «Весь путь»): between two steps of one stage, on the side without labels, at most every third stop; grey where the road is still closed.
model: gpt_image_2_5 (Higgsfield), variant flare, quality high, 1k, 4:3, transparent background
references: Vespi pieces pass the three identity references as image_references: ab833075-dfc7-4e28-824c-7e299aad556c, a448f972-9035-4be6-b0ca-1f0f7800f1a5, 0f6d7ac4-4e85-4761-9765-753f578eec1e. Landmarks use no reference.
landmarkTemplate: A handmade miniature diorama of [subject], like a lovingly crafted tabletop model for a stop-motion film: [materials: matte clay with gentle hand-sculpted imperfections, felt and wool trees, resin water]. It stands on a low irregular patch of real ground, [ground], whose edges fade softly to nothing, so it reads as a place beside a road rather than an icon: no pedestal, no base plate, no floating island, no cut-out slab. Gentle contact shadow. Soft warm late-morning daylight from the upper left, three-quarter view from slightly above, centred with a little air around it. Warm palette of cream, sand, terracotta red, olive and sage green. Isolated on a fully transparent background with clean edges, no glow, no halo, no sky, no backdrop. No people, no figures, no text, letters, signs, numbers, logos or flags.
vespiTemplate: The exact same handmade toy character as in the reference images (Vespi): almost smooth cream cotton body with fine fibers and a few loose seam threads, glossy satin red helmet with a cream center stripe and a small olive side button, tiny embroidered black dot eyes, small pink cheeks, [face], olive-green felt cape collar with one red button. [scene, on a low irregular patch of ground whose edges fade softly to nothing: no pedestal, no base plate, no floating island] Gentle contact shadows. Soft warm daylight from the upper left, three-quarter view from slightly above, like a premium stop-motion set. Isolated on a fully transparent background with clean edges, no glow, no halo, no sky, no backdrop. No text, letters, numbers, logos or flags, no other characters.
processing: Cropped to the alpha bounding box (alpha > 4%) plus 10px, exported as WebP q86 with alpha at 280 and 560 px wide (public/illustrations/scenery/); 1168x880 masters as WebP q92 in design/illustrations/source/scenery/. Grey versions for the closed part of the road (`-grey-280/560`): ImageMagick `-modulate 100,0,100 -fill #B8A890 -colorize 22% -brightness-contrast 10x-14`, alpha × 0.62; pre-rendered so no CSS filter runs on the path.
